create_mesh_from_catalog: create a Mesh from a named catalog entry using create_mesh with a mesh name string
create_mesh_with_tensors: create a Mesh object by passing vertices and faces tensors directly to the constructor
load_mesh_data: load mesh vertices or faces from a pickle file as a torch tensor using load_mesh_data
load_mesh_symmetry: load mesh symmetry vertex transforms from a pickle file using load_mesh_symmetry with LRU caching
move_mesh_to_device: move a Mesh and all its tensors to a new device using the to method
